crossRefs.note: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all…
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
“As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
“For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.
In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel…
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have…

translations.web: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
translations.bsb: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
translations.kjv: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
translations.asv: For thy lovingkindness is great unto the heavens, And thy truth unto the skies.
